full_judgment:
5. The trial court, on consideration of the evidence adduced by both the parties decreed the suit by the judgment and order dated 18.02.2007. 

 6. Being aggrieved by this judgment and decree of the trial court the defendant No. 1 preferred First Appeal No. 128 of 2007 before the High Court Division. A Division Bench of the High Court Division, after hearing both the parties dismissed that appeal affirming the judgment and decree of the trail court by the impugned judgment and order. 

 10. However, we find that the trial court did not commit any wrong or illegality in decreeing the suit and the High Court Division also rightly affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial court. So we find no reason to interfere with these concurrent findings and decision of the trial court and the High Court Division.
